question: Was machen der Mann und die Frau?
notes: English tap 1 'to cook on the stove' is true only in the first two boxed frames; in most boxed frames the woman dances and twirls, so 'sich im Kreis drehen' (the man does not spin). English tap 2 'to hold the woman' is true only in the last boxed frames (the dip); in most boxed frames the man comes in and dances with her, so 'mit der Frau tanzen'. 'langen' replaced by 'bunten': the skirt is knee to calf length and very colourful. Key word das Tanzen is not a noun of the set, so no noun row; tap 2 gaps 'tanzen'.
